nicaragua.title: Flag of the Republic of Nicaragua

colors.note: Upper and lower bands; represents the Caribbean Sea and Pacific Ocean.
Central band bearing the coat of arms; represents peace, integrity, and purity.
Sun rays and detailing on the coat of arms; symbolises the sun rising over the isthmus.

desc:
- Three horizontal bands of cobalt blue, white, and cobalt blue with the national coat of arms on the central band
- The coat of arms features a triangle (equality), five volcanoes (the Central American union), a Phrygian cap, a rainbow, and the words Republica de Nicaragua America Central
- Adopted on 4 September 1908 during the presidency of Jose Santos Zelaya
trivia:
- Nicaragua and Argentina are among the few countries whose flag colours are used to depict a rainbow on the coat of arms
- The five volcanoes on the coat of arms represent the five original states of the United Provinces of Central America
- The flag colours trace back directly to Manuel Jose Arce's banner for the Central American federation of 1823
